description: This file defines a custom annotation '@Handler' used to annotate classes serving as handlers for other classes within the OpenMRS framework. The annotation specifies which classes the handler can support and optionally an order for precedence.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: A custom annotation interface to mark classes as handlers with specified supported classes and order.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Returns an array of Classes that the annotated handler can support.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Specifies the relative order (precedence) of the handler among others of the same type.
